selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu reported one certificate added; OpenSSL subsequently verified the CA successfully through the system CA bundle.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 4b7ded33-b5e2-42c9-b7f2-bd671942a82d, received safe reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID efbf8f28-6f62-4ef2-84e0-8354bb2bcda4, and verified the running system retained the same CA fingerprint, trusted status, private key, and key/certificate pairing.

commands.command:
set -eu
for p in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then printf 'exists %s\n' "$p"; else printf 'absent %s\n' "$p"; fi
done
if [ -e /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt ]; then openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -fingerprint -sha256; fi

set -eu
sudo -n sh -c 'umask 077; openssl genrsa -out /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key 4096 >/dev/null 2>&1'
sudo -n openssl req -new -x509 -sha256 -days 3650 -key /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -config /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf -extensions v3_ca
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo -n chmod 644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
printf 'created CA key and certificate\n'

commands.command:
set -eu
CERT=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
KEY=/etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -subject -issuer -dates -fingerprint -sha256
printf 'basic_constraints='; openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -text | awk '/Basic Constraints/{getline; gsub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); print; exit}'
printf 'key_permissions='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$KEY"
openssl rsa -in "$KEY" -check -noout >/dev/null 2>&1
KFP=$(openssl rsa -in "$KEY" -pubout 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
CFP=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -pubkey -noout | openssl sha256)
[ "$KFP" = "$CFP" ]
printf 'key_matches_certificate=yes\n'
printf 'trust_verification='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$CERT"
printf 'hashed_trust_link='; readlink -f "/etc/ssl/certs/$(openssl x509 -hash -noout -in "$CERT").0"
